label: Diagram 6
caption: Diagram 6 Examples of acceptable step profiles and key dimensions for external stairs
description: Diagram 6, on the right, headed "Examples of acceptable step profiles and key dimensions for external stairs", shows three step‑profile sections stacked vertically, each drawn as a staircase silhouette rising to the right, the middle and bottom profiles having a diagonal line beneath them and the top profile none. The top profile is preceded by the text "Steps without projecting nosings are preferred" and carries no dimensions. The middle profile is marked "25mm max. overlap" at a small step‑edge projection, "280mm to 425mm" as a horizontal going dimension, and "150mm to 170mm" as a vertical rise dimension. The bottom profile is marked "25mm max. overlap" and "60° min.", the latter shown with an angle symbol at the lowest step. A note below reads "Note: Rise and going dimensions apply to all step profiles". To the left, Diagram 5, headed "External steps and stairs – key dimensions", shows a stair section with a pitch line and handrail, dimensioned "900mm to 1000mm above pitch line", "300mm min." (twice), "900mm to 1100mm" (twice), and "12 risers max., going less than 350mm" / "18 risers max., (going 350mm or more)", above a text list k–p.
